zh: 两个串长度都不超过50，可以枚举content中每个长度为|target|的窗口，逐个单独判断。
一次相邻交换只改动两个相邻位置。所以窗口要么与target完全相同，要么恰好有两个不同的位置，而且这两个位置相邻。
对每个起点收集窗口与target不同的下标：没有不同就计数；恰有两个下标i、i+1，并且窗口[i]=target[i+1]、窗口[i+1]=target[i]时也计数；其余情况不计。输出总数。
en: Both lengths are at most 50, so you can enumerate every window of length |target| in content and judge each one separately.
One adjacent swap changes only two adjacent positions. So a window either equals target exactly, or differs in exactly two positions that are next to each other.

For each start, collect the indices where the window differs from target: with no difference, count it; with exactly two indices i and i+1 where window[i]=target[i+1] and window[i+1]=target[i], count it too; otherwise do not. Output the total.

explanationEn:
## Approach

For each window, find the positions that differ. If there are none, it is valid; otherwise there must be exactly two differing positions, adjacent to each other, whose characters match crosswise after the swap.

## Proof of correctness

One adjacent swap affects at most two adjacent positions. If the window is not equal to begin with, a valid swap must fix exactly those two differing positions, and crosswise equality is both necessary and sufficient; zero differing positions are handled by doing nothing. Enumerating every start position misses nothing.

## Complexity

Time O(|content|·|target|), space O(|target|).
